profiles.label: Relatório gerencial
principles: Use backend aggregates for population totals.
Do not rename annual projected savings as measured recovered volume.

profiles.label: Relatório técnico
profiles.audience: Operação e diagnóstico de equipamentos e casos
sections: Diagnóstico por dimensão ou histórico do caso
principles: Distinguish observation, stored estimate and hypothesis.
Logger health, freshness and observation quality are separate dimensions.
Never fabricate unavailable images, raw telemetry or full tracks.
